⚠ THE OTHER 24 DO NOT YIELD AN AREA, AND THE CAUSE IS THE PARSER, NOT THE SURVEY: this instrument's surveyor writes direction as an INTERCARDINAL adverb ('northwesterly', 'southeasterly') plus a stated INTERIOR ANGLE with the previous course. metes.py resolves only the four cardinal -ly adverbs and reads no relative angle, so those courses are dropped or given a 45°-grid azimuth the description never intended. Refusing is correct under the standing rule (an unparseable course beats a silently wrong one) but it is a capability gap, not a defect in the document.
